description: PURE-FastMHL FFN replacement, PARAMETER-MATCHED to exp032 (35,792,640) -- the opposite control to exp034 (linear-only). The dense 384->1536->384 GELU FFN is replaced by ONLY a hard FastMultiHeadLut: NO parallel linear, NO GELU, NO dense FFN. x = x + fastmhl(h), h = ln2(x). FastMHL = a PLAIN fixed-anchor-pair FastMultiHeadLut (classic sign-test addressing -- NOT HyperplaneMHL) with n_heads=1, n_outputs=384, NAP=6, tph=48, HARD forward (full soft-surrogate backward -> grads reach tables AND flow densely back into h), fp32 (use_bf16=False, matching the fp32 model), near-zero table init (1e-3), per-layer anchor/init seed = 1000 + layer_idx. PARAM MATCH (EXACT): with no linear consuming budget, per-layer FastMHL = tph*2^NAP*384 = 48*64*384 = 1,179,648 = EXACTLY the removed FFN's 1,179,648/layer -> total = 35,792,640 = exp032 EXACTLY, delta 0. The FFN slot ~= 0 at init. MATCHED 4096-step run vs exp032 (byte-identical everything else: MinimalGPT+RoPE, d384/6L/6H/seq512, device_bs 48, total_bs 24576, n_steps 4096, lr 3e-4, wd 0.1, warmup 0.1, eval_every 200, seed 1, vocab 32768, same data). Optimizer: LUT-table weights in the NO-weight-decay AdamW group (project lesson: LUT tables take no wd); all other params grouped exactly as exp032. Four-way comparison: exp032 dense-FFN 1.39371, exp033 Linear||FastMHL 1.41430, exp034 Linear-only 1.47970, exp035 FastMHL-only (this).
